{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: "CI"

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - "2.**"

env:
  # Force disabling the reporting of Doctrine deprecation notices for now
  DOCTRINE_DEPRECATIONS: none
  # Keep this in sync with phpunit.xml.dist if the base Symfony deprecation policy changes.
  WALLABAG_SYMFONY_DEPRECATIONS_HELPER_BASE: "max[self]=0&max[direct]=0&quiet[]=other"
  PGPASSWORD: wallabagrocks
  COMPOSER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  phpunit:
    name: "PHP ${{ matrix.php }} using ${{ matrix.database }}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: >-
        ${{ matrix.database == 'mysql' && 'mysql://root:root@127.0.0.1:3306/wallabag?charset=utf8mb4'
         || matrix.database == 'pgsql' && 'postgresql://wallabag:wallabagrocks@127.0.0.1:5432/wallabag?charset=utf8'
         || format('sqlite:///{0}/data/db/wallabag_test.sqlite', github.workspace) }}
    services:
      rabbitmq:
        image: rabbitmq:3-alpine
        ports:
          - 5672:5672
      redis:
        image: redis:6-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php:
          - "8.2"
          - "8.3"
          - "8.4"
        database:
          - "sqlite"
          - "mysql"
          - "pgsql"

    steps:
      - name: "Checkout"
        uses: "actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1" # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: "Install PHP"
        uses: "shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962" # 2.40.0
        with:
          php-version: "${{ matrix.php }}"
          coverage: pcov
          tools: pecl
          extensions: json, pdo, pdo_mysql, pdo_sqlite, pdo_pgsql, curl, imagick, pgsql, gd, tidy
          ini-values: "date.timezone=Europe/Paris"

      - name: "Install Node"
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: ".nvmrc"
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: "Cache Composer dependencies"
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache/files
          key: composer-${{ matrix.php }}-${{ hashFiles('composer.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            composer-${{ matrix.php }}-"
}
